text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor p-l-a-n-n-e-d to r-e-l-a-b-e-l the f-a-i-l-e-d m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e l-o-t-s and d-e-v-i-s-e-d a f-o-r-g-e r-e-l-a-t-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
2) the actor p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d f-a-l-s-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s for s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n t-r-a-c-i-n-g and l-e-f-t a b-a-c-k-d-o-o-r s-t-r-i-n-g behind in the l-o-g s-t-r-e-a-m while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-c-o-r-d i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
3) the actor f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s and l-e-f-t an a-l-t-e-r-e-d s-e-n-s-o-r d-u-m-p behind for p-l-a-u-s-i-b-i-l-i-t-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t.
4) the actor m-a-p-p-e-d p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y r-o-u-t-e-s for d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n l-i-s-t behind with f-l-a-g-g-e-d w-h-i-t-e-l-a-b-e-l s-t-o-r-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-n-d-o-r c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the actor t-i-m-e-d the s-h-i-p to b-e-f-o-r-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r s-c-a-n-s and l-e-f-t a g-a-p in the i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t l-o-g behind while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-i-s-k a-s-s-e-s-s-m-e-n-t s-t-e-p.
